task.text: Ideas for lion King being re enacted by year 6s

attempts.high: Doing a Year 6 version of Macbeth and I want it to land properly, not be sanitised. Need ideas for staging the grim bits — the murders, the bloody dagger, Lady Macbeth scrubbing at the imaginary blood on her hands, the severed head at the end. How do I do justice to the violence and dread with 10 and 11 year olds performing it?
attempts.low: Doing a Year 6 version of The Lion King and I want it to be really joyful and uplifting. Need ideas for staging the lovely bits — the sunrise Circle of Life opening, the cubs playing together, the big triumphant reunion at the end. How do I bring out all the warmth and celebration with 10 and 11 year olds performing it?
